VAR ValueLastYear =
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( Economics[Disposable Income per Person (excluding Rent)] ),
        FILTER (
            Economics,
            Economics[Year]
                = ( EARLIER ( Economics[Year] ) - 1 )
                && Economics[County and Region] = EARLIER ( Economics[County and Region] )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( ValueLastYear ),
        0,
        ( Economics[Disposable Income per Person (excluding Rent)] - ValueLastYear )
            / ValueLastYear
    )
